title: Appointed as Assistant
original: I'll gladly offer my help if you need it. Just remember to return the favor someday.

title: Talk 1
original: Vina... Err, I mean, Miss Siege—always gives me this feeling I can't describe. I wonder why...?

title: Talk 2
original: My dad? Oh my, you know I ran away from home and you're still going to ask me that? Doctor, are you perhaps not the best at conversation?

title: Talk 3
original: Dr. {@nickname}! Do have a try of my cooking... You taste medicine? Oh, gosh... Well, I do have some knowledge in herbs, but you know I wouldn't be experimenting on you, would I? Eheheh...

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I used to think my parents were so stuffy and numb to it all, so I ran away from home to find a new life. But after having traveled so far and been through so much, I've come to realize why my parents felt how they did now. Ahahah, c'est la vie, as the saying goes.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Dr. {@nickname}, see that lone cloud over there, off from the rest? That's the way my hometown lies.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Faith' is an interesting topic. I never had the chance to go to Laterano, but how funny I should hear all about its feats on Rhodes Island? Although I've mostly heard about, er... one very overly active girl. Has Laterano always been such a lively place?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: The boats of Toron need a lighthouse to make their way back to port, and Rhodes Island has served as the safe haven at the end of my trip. Dr. {@nickname}, your light might not illuminate the whole harbor, but go on... Do what I couldn't. It's my honest request.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Right here, right now, is where I, Grace Arizona, place my faith. Dr. {@nickname}, you hold my hopes in your hands, forever more.

title: Idle
original: ...That's the face of someone lost in their dreams. I wonder if you're feeling uneasy, Doctor?

title: Onboard
original: Breeze, a traveling scholar from Toron County. It is a pleasure to meet you, Doctor. Phew, I've had enough of formal etiquette, so this will be the last of it.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: ...Stunning medical skills. There's Rhodes Island for you...

title: Promotion 1
original: I bestow my heartfelt blessings on you for your gift, Doctor. Hmm? What a shoddy reaction—this is a hand-kiss, you know, we're being serious here. Hurry up, come on!

title: Promotion 2
original: Well, this time won't be as mannerful as the last, not that I'd think you were hoping for that? So here goes. I will dedicate everything to Rhodes Island, a pledge that transcends my consciousness.

title: Added to Squad
original: Leave the medical work to me.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Thank you for your trust. I will make sure to prioritize the safety of the Operators.

title: Depart
original: It's getting windy...

title: Begin Operation
original: Those who seek to inflict harm on others have no right to ask for forgiveness.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Here.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Awaiting orders.

title: Deployment 1
original: Let's get this done quickly.

title: Deployment 2
original: Make sure to look after yourself.

title: In Battle 1
original: Rings through winds the Eulogy…

title: In Battle 2
original: Sings the breeze an elegy!

title: In Battle 3
original: We have the will!

title: 4-star Result
original: Everyone, victory is ours.

title: 3-star Result
original: Every victory creates a kindling that will flourish into an everlasting fire.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Keep your senses alert. The wind is still restless.

title: Operation Failure
original: Why are they so fixated on hurting others...?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: What a... unique place this is.

title: Tap
original: Wait, wait!

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, would you like to hear the story of my hometown?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor. Seems a whole year's flown by. How long does that make it since I left home, then... wait, don't give me that look, or the head-patting! I'm not homesick!

title: Greeting
original: Good day, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's three slices of Victorian cake. One of—excuse me, what's the rush? I didn't even finish yet. Lucky you to pick the spicy one. Come on, wash that down with a spot of tea.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I wonder from time to time what my parents would think of me now, working at Rhodes Island. Would they be proud of me? Or maybe they still wouldn't forgive me... Either way, saving more lives is an ideal I'll never be swayed from.
